account.note: A SPECIFICATION IS PUBLISHED AND IT IS FORCED ON ITEM 2: buy 6 SMCI at a 39.64 limit, target 47.57, stop 36.47, time stop the 8/19 close, expiring 10:30. Cost 237.84 - 23.5% of this 1012.33 account, against a 40% single-name ceiling and 919.58 of settled cash. THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE 8/10 after three consecutive misses, and this is the first open run to clear its own staleness guard since then: fired 09:40 against 09:33, seven minutes late where 8/11 was 247 and 8/12 was 846. THE FAILING ITEM IS 2 AND IT IS THE REAL THING, NOT A TECHNICALITY. SMCI printed 8/11 after the close, gapped 8/12 from 31.60 to a 37.61 close on 165.7M shares against a 56.6M average, and is +5.32% again today. The rulebook buys the day-2/3 PULLBACK after strength; there has been no pullback, today's 38.20 low is above yesterday's close, and the entry sits 25.4% above the pre-print 31.60. That is buying extension, which is what item 2 refuses. It was taken because SMCI is the ONLY name on this twelve-name board with a dated catalyst inside a five-session hold - the calendar was pulled live at 502 events across 8/13 to 8/19 and NOT ONE watched name appears - so every alternative fails item 1 instead, and item 1 is the more fundamental question. ITEM 5 IS LOGGED 'ne' AND IS A GAP RATHER THAN A PASS: the rule's own case is crowding into a print and no print is ahead, but whether a +19% reaction has already priced the beat is a real question this run has no positioning data to answer and did not invent one for. OPTIONS CLEARED THE 10% SPREAD TEST FOR THE FIRST TIME ON THIS BOARD. Three SMCI 2026-09-18 calls pulled from the live chain: the 38 at 4.65/4.85 on 4,213 open interest and 0.625 delta, a 4.21% spread; the 39 at 4.15/4.40 on 1,635 and 0.584 delta, 5.85%; the 40 at 3.75/3.95 on 14,793 open interest and 0.544 delta, 5.19%. All three clear the 10% ceiling, the 0.40 delta floor and the 3-6 week window at 36 days. The refusal carried since 8/5 was about SOUN, SMR and UPST quoting 15-45% of mark - it was never about options as an instrument, and it took the first genuinely liquid chain this board has examined to establish that. THE OPTION WAS STILL NOT CHOSEN AND THE ARITHMETIC IS THE REASON: one 40-strike contract at the 3.85 mark is 385.00, or 38.0% of the account against a 40% ceiling, and a -40% option stop puts 154.00 at risk - 15.2% of the account - on a thesis just marked forced. Theta -0.0556 a day costs about 10% of premium over five flat sessions before direction, and vega 0.0496 against a still-elevated 78.5% IV costs another 17% on a 13-point post-print decay. Six shares risk 19.03 at the stop against 154.00. The equity loses only when the direction is wrong, and the direction is the only thing this thesis is claiming. NO EXIT WAS DUE. All four OKLO levels checked against a live 45.61 bid: 2 shares at a 45.1499 average, +1.02%, target 54.18 needs +18.79%, stop 41.54 needs -8.92%, time stop the 8/14 close with today session 4 of 5. The option position list was queried live and is EMPTY, so no no-fly window closes on anything, and OKLO appears in none of the 502 calendar events. Nothing sold, no exit specification owed. THE 8/12 BLACKOUT IS CLOSED OUT RATHER THAN CARRIED FORWARD: nine slots produced no row, the 23:39 retro proved from 30-minute bars that neither OKLO level traded on session 3, and this run confirms the position live at 2 shares and a 45.1499 average, unchanged. BREADTH IS 11 GREEN OF 12 ON THE BID with only LEU red at -0.12%, and that is stated as a caution rather than a tailwind: on a tape where everything is up, a name's own move is mostly beta and the catalyst is what has to carry it. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending and nothing unsettled.
account.priorNote: THE OVERNIGHT HOLD ON OKLO IS THIS RUN'S DECISION AND IT IS A HOLD. Four levels checked against a live 46.99 bid, four clear, nothing sold, no exit specification owed. 2 shares at a 45.1499 average: +4.08%, 3.68 of unrealized gain on a 90.30 cost. The 54.18 target needs the bid up a further 15.30%; the 41.54 stop needs it down 11.60%; the time stop is the 8/14 close with today session 2 of 5. THE LEVEL THAT WOULD CHANGE IT IS 41.54, written down today rather than inherited from the day the position opened, and it is the same number tomorrow whatever the tape does tonight. BOTH MECHANICAL NO-HOLD CHECKS RAN AND BOTH ARE CLEAN. No option is held - the option position list was queried live and returned empty - so NO NO-FLY WINDOW CLOSES ON ANYTHING TODAY. And no earnings land tonight on the underlying: the calendar was pulled live at 760 events across 8/11 to 8/15 and OKLO appears in none of them, so no straddle was owed on this position and none is claimed. The rule that no straddle pulled means no earnings hold is satisfied here by there being no earnings, which is the only honest way to satisfy it without a quote. FIRED 15:34 AGAINST A 15:33 SLOT, one minute late and the closest to its own window any run has fired today, on board quotes struck in a nineteen-second span at 19:35:29-19:35:48 UTC. NO POSITION WAS OPENED AND THAT IS THE SLOT RATHER THAN THE READ. The pre-close may not open in the last thirty minutes; the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot, which closed at the staleness guard 247 minutes late this morning, so 2026-08-11 ends with the mandate undischarged and the reason on the record. THE MOVES PASS THE 15:21 HOURLY HANDED OVER WAS DONE, AND HALF OF WHAT IT ASKED FOR WAS IMPOSSIBLE. It asked this run to prune the SMCI row 'once tonight's print has passed' - the print is after the 16:00 close and this run fires at 15:33, so the print cannot pass inside this window and deleting the row would be erasing a catalyst that has not happened. The row stays and the 8/12 open prunes it. What WAS owed and is now done: spot and straddle re-struck together inside three seconds at 15:36. SMCI 31.34 spot; the 8/14 31.50 straddle marks 4.515, a 14.4% implied move, recorded as 0.144. On the constant 32 strike the series reads 14.2%, 13.7%, now 14.6% - the implied move WIDENED into the print, and it is measurable only because the old strike was quoted beside the new ATM one instead of being replaced by it. The refusal is unchanged and is further from close than it has been: an 8% stop inside a 14.4% move is a stop the event gaps rather than fills. THE NUCLEAR SPREAD NARROWED A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR, WHICH FINISHES OFF THE FINDING TWO RUNS AGO LED WITH. SMR +6.32%, OKLO +5.62%, LEU -0.26% - 6.58 points against 6.83 at 15:21, 7.25 at 14:22 and 6.62 at 13:41. Four reads have produced narrow, wide, narrower, narrowest. The 14:21 run called the widening its one real finding; it was noise, it has fully round-tripped, and saying so plainly is worth more than the original entry was. What survives all four reads is only the narrow claim that this complex does not move as one thing intraday. BREADTH IS FROZEN FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE READ at 6 green of 12 with the identical six names - OKLO, SMR, MARA, IONQ, RGTI and AMD green; LEU, SMCI, SOUN, QBTS, UPST and JOBY red - only magnitudes moving. ORDER RECORD QUERIED DIRECTLY AN ELEVENTH TIME AND UNCHANGED: exactly one order in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET on 8/10 at 45.1499 against a 45.40 limit, tagged agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. The escalation stands open, unanswered and uncompounded across eleven checks. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending and no pending deposits.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.

positions.note: HELD, AND THIS IS THE FIRST LOOK AT IT IN TWO SESSIONS. Four levels checked against a live 45.61 bid and four clear: 2 shares at a 45.1499 average, +1.02%, 0.92 of unrealized gain on a 90.30 cost. The 54.18 target needs the bid up a further 18.79%; the 41.54 stop needs it down 8.92%; the time stop is the 8/14 close and today is SESSION 4 OF 5, so exactly one session exists after this one. THE POSITION IS VERIFIED INTACT RATHER THAN ASSUMED INTACT. The whole of 8/12 produced no run inside its window - nine slots, no row - and the position went unlooked-at through session 3. The 23:39 retro proved from the full 30-minute series that neither level traded (session low 44.73, 7.68% above the stop; high 48.15, 11.14% below the target), and this run confirms the holding live at 2 shares and a 45.1499 average, unchanged, with zero option positions beside it. THE STOP IS THE NEAREST IT HAS READ SINCE THE FILL, AND THAT IS THE HONEST DIRECTION TO REPORT IT IN. 8.92% away, against 11.60% at the 8/11 bell, 11.99% at 15:21 and 7.3% at Friday's. It widened all last week because the price rose and it has narrowed the same way; distance-to-stop is a fact about price, not a cushion anyone earned, and a run that only reports it when it widens is telling half of it. THE TIME STOP IS NOW THE LIVE LEVEL RATHER THAN THE FAR ONE. At +1.02% after four sessions this position has gone essentially nowhere, which is precisely the case the ~5 session rule was written for: if nothing happens the thesis was wrong even where the stop never hits. Tomorrow's close sells it unless 54.18 or 41.54 speaks first, and the 8/10 rule says plainly that the time stop is not extendable by conviction. That is written down today rather than discovered tomorrow afternoon. NO SAME-DAY EXIT TRIGGER FIRES. No option is held so no no-fly window closes, and OKLO appears in none of the 502 calendar events pulled live across 8/13 to 8/19, so no print lands inside the remaining hold and no straddle is owed or claimed. Size unchanged at 91.22 on the bid, 9.01% of the account and still under the ~10% threshold where the 8/10 rule warns rather than blocks. Provenance unchanged after a twelfth check: one order in this account since 8/7, tagged agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. Tagged nuclear, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position - and the SMCI entry published today is ai-hardware, so it does not touch that cap.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI day-2 post-earnings continuation - BOUGHT, forced on item 2, and the pre-written branch is discharged against its own terms
entryWatch.trigger: Live: a 6-share buy at a 39.64 limit, target 47.57, stop 36.47, time stop the 8/19 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Bid 39.61 / ask 39.64 struck 13:46:16 UTC.
entryWatch.why: THE BRANCH WRITTEN BEFORE THE PRINT IS DISCHARGED, AND IT ANSWERS AGAINST THIS ENTRY. moves.json carried, since before the 8/11 close, the instruction 'SMCI still wanted after the print - re-approach from 8/12, on the reaction bar rather than into it', with the explicit qualifier that 'the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2/3 pullback that holds is'. Today is day 2 and there is no pullback: SMCI gapped 8/12 from a 31.60 close to 37.61 on 165.7M shares against a 56.6M average, opened today at 38.24, has a session low of 38.20 that sits ABOVE yesterday's close, and is +5.32% on the bid. So the branch's test is met by the calendar and failed by the tape, and the entry is published FORCED on item 2 rather than argued into a pass. THE REASON IT WAS TAKEN IS THAT THE ALTERNATIVE FAILURE IS WORSE. The earnings calendar was pulled live at 502 events across 8/13 to 8/19 and NOT ONE of the twelve watched names appears in it, so no other candidate can answer 'why does this move meaningfully, soon' at all - every alternative fails item 1, the more fundamental question, and the 8/10 JOBY entry is this board's own record of what an item-1 failure looks like. A dated catalyst bought too high is a different error from no catalyst at all, and it is the one this run chose. WHAT THE BETTER SETUP WOULD HAVE BEEN, STATED SO THE GRADER CAN CHECK IT: a hold of the 38.20 session low or a fade toward the 37.61 close on lighter volume, bought there rather than here, which is the day-2/3 pullback the rulebook names. It does not exist inside this 30-to-60 minute window and no limit was placed below the market to pretend otherwise - a spec priced where it cannot fill is standing aside wearing the mandate's clothes, and that is the one dishonesty the mandate forbids outright.

entryWatch.setup: Options are available for the first time - the standing spread refusal was about the names, not the instrument
entryWatch.trigger: SMCI 2026-09-18 calls, live chain: the 40 strike bid 3.75 / ask 3.95, a 5.19% spread on 14,793 open interest and 0.544 delta. The 38 reads 4.21% and the 39 reads 5.85%.
entryWatch.why: A CLAIM THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED SINCE 8/5 IS RETIRED, AND IT WAS ALWAYS NARROWER THAN IT SOUNDED. Options were refused three-plus sessions running on spread - most recently at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, on the tightest of eight live quotes - and docs/RULES.md records the finding as 'the shape of the universe, not three unlucky picks'. What the universe actually was: SOUN, SMR and UPST, three small low-priced names, quoted at 15-45% of mark. The first genuinely liquid chain this board has pulled clears the ceiling on all three strikes examined, at 36 days to expiry and 0.54-0.63 delta. So the correct statement is that the names this account could afford had unusable option markets, not that options are unusable at this account size - and the 8/10 note that 'no balance narrows a spread' is true and was answering a question nobody should have been asking. THE CONTRACT WAS STILL NOT BOUGHT, ON ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN ON THE OLD REFUSAL. One 40-strike contract at the 3.85 mark is 385.00, 38.0% of a 1012.33 account against a 40% ceiling, and the rulebook's -40% option stop puts 154.00 at risk - 15.2% of the account - behind a thesis this run has itself marked forced. Theta -0.0556 a day takes about 10% of premium over five flat sessions and vega 0.0496 against a still-elevated 78.5% post-print IV takes about 17% more on a 13-point decay, so the contract can lose a quarter of its value while the thesis is neither right nor wrong. The 6-share equity risks 19.03 at its stop and loses only on direction. THIS ROW IS THE FINDING AND NOT A PLAN. The next time a liquid chain appears beside a thesis that is NOT forced, the option is genuinely on the table for the first time; recorded now so that decision is made against a quoted precedent rather than against a rule of thumb nobody re-tested.

entryWatch.setup: Breadth is 11 green of 12 and the entry is being taken into it - stated as a caution, not a tailwind
entryWatch.trigger: No level. 11 green of 12 on the bid at 09:46, LEU alone red at -0.12%, with the range running SMCI +5.32% down to JOBY +0.13%.
entryWatch.why: ITEM 2's SECOND SENTENCE IS THE ONE THAT APPLIES HERE AND IT IS RECORDED AGAINST THIS RUN'S OWN ENTRY. 'If the whole list is green 5-10%, that is a wait signal, not a buy signal.' The list is not green 5-10% - the magnitudes run +0.13% to +5.32% and only SMCI is above 4% - so the sentence does not fire on its terms, and this row says so rather than stretching it into a refusal it does not support. What IS true and is worth more than the letter of the rule: on a tape where eleven of twelve names are up, most of any one name's move is the tape, and the part of SMCI's +5.32% that belongs to SMCI is smaller than it looks at 09:46. That is the argument for the catalyst having to carry the position rather than the momentum, and it is the argument for the -8% stop being tight against a name whose own session range is already 4.2% wide. Both are written down before the outcome. THE COMPLEX PICTURE IS UNCHANGED AND UNCROWDED. OKLO holds one nuclear slot; SMR at +1.67% and LEU at -0.12% could take the second and neither has a catalyst. The SMCI entry is ai-hardware, a complex this book has never held, so the two-per-complex cap is nowhere near binding and no stop in this book gaps with another. AMD at a 496.00 bid is the only other ai-hardware name on the list and is refused mechanically at 49.0% of the account against a 40% ceiling, which also means the complex cannot accidentally fill from that direction. THE DEAD JOBY SPECIFICATION IS RETIRED FROM THIS FILE. The forced 8.85 limit expired unfilled on 8/10; JOBY is 7.97 bid, -9.94% against it, and has been red against that limit at every one of thirteen reads since. The point is made and re-marking it a fourteenth time adds nothing.

candidates.note: 39.61 bid, +5.32%, the best name on the board and the one bought today. Today's 38.20 low sits above yesterday's close and the entry is 25.4% above the pre-print 31.60, so this is day-2 extension and not the day-2/3 pullback the rulebook buys. Bought anyway, marked forced, at 23.5% of the account. Liquidity is the best on this list by a distance - 28.2B market cap, a 39.61/39.64 equity spread at 0.08%, and an option chain quoting 4-6% of mark.
